pageDescription: How often incidents happen, how fast they are handled, how well Keigan's investigations hold up and what the AI uses.
percentilesNote: Each figure is the median (half of the cases were faster), then p90 (nine in ten were faster) and n, the number of cases behind it. Figures from only a few cases can swing a lot.

empty.title: No incidents or investigations in this period
empty.description: Choose a longer period or another application. Figures appear as soon as there is data.

reasons.timeToDetect: no alert before the incident was opened
reasons.outOfOrder: start or end time missing or out of order

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Opened and resolved in this period, and how quickly they were detected, answered and closed.

investigations.title: Keigan investigations
investigations.description: What Keigan investigated and how engineers rated the result.

ai.title: AI usage
ai.description: Per investigation. Model calls that belong to no investigation, such as chat, are not counted here.

trend.title: Weekly trend
trend.description: The same figures week by week.

applications.title: By application
applications.description: Only applications you can read. Select a column heading to sort.

definitions.title: How these figures are defined
definitions.description: Every figure on this page is calculated as follows.

reasons.no_acknowledgement_timestamp: Keigan does not record when a person acknowledges an incident, so this cannot be calculated. It is not estimated.
reasons.unknown: The data needed for this figure is not recorded.

ratings.notEnough: Not enough ratings yet ({{count}} of {{minimum}} needed)
ratings.detail: {{rated}} of {{total}} rated: {{correct}} correct, {{partial}} partly correct, {{incorrect}} incorrect

ai.costTotal: Total {{total}} (in the currency of the configured prices)
ai.noPricedInvestigations: No investigation used only priced models
ai.noPricesText: Cost is estimated only when an administrator has configured a price per model. Until then this page shows tokens only.
ai.unpricedText: Left out of the estimate: {{models}}. {{count}} investigations used them, so their cost is not shown.

trend.resolve: Median time to resolve per week (hours)
trend.conclusion: Median time to conclusion per week (minutes)
trend.tokens: Median tokens per investigation per week
trend.samples: Cases behind each bar, week by week: {{counts}}
trend.note: Weeks start on Monday (UTC). A week with no cases has no bar. The first and last week may be only partly inside the period.

percentiles.title: Median, p90 and n
percentiles.text: The median is the middle case: half were faster, half slower. p90 is the value nine in ten cases stayed under, so it shows the slow tail. n is the number of cases behind the figure. Both are interpolated between ranks.

incidentsOpened.title: Incidents opened
incidentsOpened.text: Incidents whose opened time falls inside the period, split by the priority Keigan gave them.

incidentsResolved.title: Incidents resolved
incidentsResolved.text: Incidents whose resolved time falls inside the period, even if they were opened earlier.

timeToDetect.title: Time to detect
timeToDetect.text: From the first alert in an alert group linked to the incident to the time the incident was opened. It shows how long a signal existed before an incident did, not when the problem really began. Incidents with no earlier alert are left out and counted.

timeToFirstUpdate.title: Time to first update
timeToFirstUpdate.text: From the moment Keigan registered the incident to the first update sent to the team. Incidents with no update sent yet are not included.

timeToResolve.title: Time to resolve (MTTR)
timeToResolve.text: From the incident being opened to it being marked resolved. Incidents that are still open are not included.

timeToConclusion.title: Time to conclusion
timeToConclusion.text: From an investigation starting to it completing, for completed investigations only.

timeToAcknowledge.title: Time to acknowledge (MTTA)
timeToAcknowledge.text: Would be the time from an incident being opened to a person acknowledging it. Keigan does not record an acknowledgement, so it is not calculated.

investigationStatuses.title: Investigations by status
investigationStatuses.text: Investigations created in the period, by where they ended up or stand now.

ratings.title: Marked correct
ratings.text: Of the investigations engineers rated, the share rated correct. Investigations nobody rated are not counted. No percentage is shown until the minimum number of ratings is reached, because a share from a handful of ratings misleads.

aiTokens.title: Tokens per investigation
aiTokens.text: Input and output tokens of all model calls made for an investigation, added up per investigation. The figure is the median and p90 across investigations.

aiLatency.title: Latency per model call
aiLatency.text: How long a single model call took, across every call made for the investigations in the period.

aiCalls.title: Model calls and failures
aiCalls.text: How many model calls were made for the investigations in the period and how many of them failed.

aiCost.title: Estimated cost
aiCost.text: Tokens multiplied by the configured price per million tokens of each model. Keigan stores no amounts, so this is an estimate and only exists when prices are configured. An investigation that used a model without a price is left out.

weeklyTrend.title: Weekly trend
weeklyTrend.text: Each bar is the median of the cases that ended in that week. Weeks start on Monday (UTC).
